A great sports bar
Aug 2026 • Friends
The Jackaroo Bar in Ho Chi Minh City is absolutely outstanding. I’ve visited on each of my last three trips to Ho Chi Minh City, and it has become my go-to place to catch my AFL and NRL fix.

Jay, the owner and manager, together with his wife and the entire team, do an exceptional job of making everyone feel welcome. The customer service is second to none and, without doubt, some of the best I’ve experienced in Ho Chi Minh City.

If you’re a beer lover, this is the place to be. Every beer is served ice cold, with an excellent range of beers on tap including Tiger, Huda and a selection of local pale ales, along with plenty of bottled beers and an extensive cocktail menu.

The atmosphere is fantastic. You’ll often meet fellow Australians, expats and travellers from around the world, creating a friendly and welcoming environment. One thing that really stands out is Jay’s attention to his customers. He’s always out on the floor, chatting with patrons and making sure everyone is enjoying themselves.

A perfect example of that was last night when a group of European tourists asked if they could watch a football match (soccer) from Europe. Jay happily switched one of the televisions over so they could enjoy the game. Nothing ever seems too much trouble.

If you’re visiting Ho Chi Minh City and looking for a great sports bar with outstanding service, excellent food and drinks, and a genuinely friendly atmosphere.

Well done, Jay, and congratulations to you and your entire team. I’ll certainly be back on my next visit.

A great place for a feed and drinks in an Aussie style bar
Jun 2026 • Friends
I have just returned from Vietnam with three of my friends. We spent a few days in Ho Chi Minh and being my fourth visit to Vietnam I was basically a tour guide for my mates. After we visited the Ben Thahn Market, we decided we would find a local bar to escape the heat of the day. 

After doing a Google search, we found the Jackaroo Bar only 80 metres from the market. We were warmly greeted by staff and the owner - Jay. It just happened that there was AFL and NRL games being played live on multiple screens. Being AFL fans, we were rapt to have a few beers in the air conditioning. The prices are very reasonable too. Jay was an awesome host and to have a great chat to, being a Melbourne boy.

Overall we had a great time at the Jackaroo Bar and wouldn’t hesitate to go back when back in Saigon.

Cheers from myself - Paul, and my friends - John & Clive.

May 2026 • Friends
Had an unreal night at the Jackaroo Bar in Ho Chi Minh City last week celebrating my birthday with five friends while on holidays in Vietnam. Cold beers, great fresh food, big screen tvs with nrl and an awesome Aussie-style menu that really hit the spot.

The staff were unbelievable — super friendly, spoke great English, and made us feel welcome from the moment we walked in. We also had a chat with the owners who were genuinely lovely people and made the whole experience even better.

If you’re an Aussie travelling through Hi Chi Min Vietnam and looking for a great atmosphere, good food, and top service, definitely check this place out. We’ll be back On our next trip.
